title: Claim-matched validation dissociates robust stimulus-locked electroencephalographic responses from cognitive validity and incremental prediction
description: Reproducible analysis code, minimized derived inputs, machine-readable results, figure source data, and tests for a three-cohort human EEG study separating stimulus-locked target engagement, reliability, matched cognitive validity, and participant-held-out incremental prediction. Source EEG recordings are not redistributed.
